messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] pbil.univ-lyon1.fr:5558 cannot be opened
messages.body_plain:
Dear seqinr user,


I used to extract sequences using seqinr functions regularly but today I received the following message when choosing the bank:

choosebank("Genbank", verbose="TRUE")


Error in socketConnection(host = host, port = port, server = server, blocking = blocking,  :
  cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In socketConnection(host = host, port = port, server = server, blocking = blocking,  :
  pbil.univ-lyon1.fr:5558 cannot be opened
Error in choosebank("genbank") :
  I wasn't able to open the socket connection:
   o Check that your are connected to the internet.
   o Check that port 5558 is not closed by a firewall.
   o Try to increase timeout value (current is 5 seconds).

Here my sessionInfo()
R version 3.2.0 (2015-04-16)
Platform: i386-w64-mingw32/i386 (32-bit)
Running under: Windows 7 (build 7601) Service Pack 1

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=French_France.1252  LC_CTYPE=French_France.1252    LC_MONETARY=French_France.1252
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C                   LC_TIME=French_France.1252

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base

other attached packages:
[1] seqinr_3.3-6

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tools_3.2.0 ade4_1.7-2


So I think the problem come from the server, in addition I also tried to access seqinr R web page (http://pbil.univ-lyon1.fr/software/SeqinR) but I got the following message:


Ce site est inaccessible

pbil.univ-lyon1.fr n'autorise pas la connexion.

  *   Acc?dez ? http://www.univ-lyon1.fr/
  *   Effectuez une recherche Google sur pbil univ lyon1 fr software SeqinR<https://www.google.co.nz/search?q=pbil%20univ%20lyon1%20fr%20software%20SeqinR>.

ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED


So it seems that the problem comes from the server that refuse the connection, but why?


For information, I'm based in New Zealand.


Thanks very much in advance!


David
